note: Small family campground under trees on a farmstead northwest of Wapello, just off US 61, with a small pond to the west. Formerly Papa's Paradise; new owners in 2026. No website; call ahead. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $25 a night in September 2026 (RV Life). --Claude
summary: Rate added from a dated camper report: $25 a night (9/2026, RV Life). Presence passes on Google (4.7/44 with phone). Water and sewer reported. Not a GS park, no gateway; long-stay character is a question (2021 report of mostly long-term residents; 2026 report of new owners and nightly stays).
flags: PRIVATE GATES: $25 a night camper-reported (RV Life, stayed 9/2026) - under $50; the operator has no website, so the camper report may price it (memory feedback_camper_report_rates) and the note carries the CAMPER-REPORTED RATE line. RV Life also tags it $$ (avg 23). Not in the Good Sam directory; no gateway within 40 km (family home 248 km); family has not stayed.

PRESENCE: pass on Google Maps - 'Whispering Maples Campground', 12729 J Ave, Wapello, open, 4.7 stars from 44 reviews, phone +1 563-272-9504 (matches stored). A 'Papa's Paradise' search returns the same panel. No website (none on Google; nothing found by search).
REVIEWS: Google 4.7 / 44; RV Life 4.5 (3 reviews: 10/10 in 9/2026, 6/10 in 8/2021, 9/10 in 6/2016); The Dyrt one five-star review. Nothing under 4.0 with 25+ reviews.

LONG-STAY (borderline, I read it as NOT mostly seasonal): RV Life 8/2021: 'This park has seen better days. Small with what mostly appears to be long term residents. Dogs running around without leashes, office and store closed during the day, owners work elsewhere.' RV Life 9/2026: 'New owners New Name " Whispering Maples Campground". We camp here every time we visit our son. We really like the park. New owners are doing a lot of enhancement. The park is quiet'. Google (4 years ago): 'My partner is a traveling welder so we have stayed in a ton of different rv parks across the country' (a worker stay); Google (8 years ago): 'We do a motorcycle trip state to state every year and we put this place on the list'. The Dyrt shows '$25.00 - $600.00' (likely a monthly rate). Five tests: 1 price $25 pass; 2 no posted nightly rate anywhere, but campers report paying nightly ($25 in 2026) - weak; 3 no minimum reported; 4 share of nightly sites unknown (2026 and older reviewers stayed nightly); 5 no homes or lots for sale seen. Report as a judgement for AWH: the 2021 residents report predates the 2026 ownership change.
NAME: the stored name matches Google; RV Life still lists it as Papa's Paradise Campground (the 2026 review says the new owners renamed it).
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' STANDS: the pond west of the sites (~95 x 40 m, about 1 acre) is ~35 m from the westmost pads behind a belt of trees.
PIN OK: stored 41.2405,-91.1935 is in the middle of the wooded site cluster.
UNVERIFIED: site count (old note ~35) and amperage - only reviews mention them (Google 5 years ago '20/30/50 amp services'; RV Life 2016 '30_amp,50_amp'); dropped from the note.
